description:

DeSoto must decide whether to amputate the leg of a trapped construction worker (James McEachin); nervous Gage faces an IRS tax audit.

Gage promises to care for an injured woman's dog; the paramedics save five lives including a diabetic and a man trapped on a ledge.

An injured cameraman proves to have more than a broken leg, leading Brackett to search for a botulism source; guest Susan Seaforth.

DeSoto and Gage deliver a baby over the father's protests; DeSoto worries about a dinner he is planning for the station-house crew.

title: Emergency!

A canyon fire threatens the residents of a housing development and keeps the paramedics on round-the-clock duty; guest Tony Dow.

DeSoto and Gage talk down an airplane flown by a teenage boy whose father, the pilot, suffered a heart attack while at the controls.

description:

The paramedics hold a demonstration for student nurses, one of whom interests Gage; the hospital staff saves a robber and his victim.

title: Emergency!

Gage resents media attention given to a paramedic (Gary Crosby) from another squad; Brackett clashes with a tycoon over a diagnosis.

title: The A-Team
description:

Gen. Stockwell (Robert Vaughn) blackmails the team into rescuing hostages held on board a Mexican airliner by terrorists.

title: The A-Team
description:

The team faces court-martial in the murder of a colonel who was cooperating with the enemy; guest David Ackroyd.

title: The A-Team
description:

Murdock and Frankie Santana ask Gen. Stockwell to help them rescue B.A., Hannibal and Face from a military firing squad.

title: The A-Team
description:

The team joins a touring pro football squad to free an East German scientist; guests Alan Autry, Jim Brown, John Matuszak, Joe Namath.

title: The A-Team
description:

The team must free three CIA agents from a Caribbean prison before an ambitious dictator strikes a deal with the Soviet military.

title: The A-Team
description:

Stockwell orders the team to steal a Soviet stealth fighter-jet, then is kidnapped by a free-lance spy (David McCallum).

title: The A-Team
description:

The team infiltrates an East Coast mob to free an undercover TV reporter from her kingpin lover.

title: The A-Team
description:

Smuggling a crooked politician into the country gets complicated when the man is Face's long-lost father.

title: The A-Team
description:

The team heads to Hong Kong to look for missing Hannibal and a stolen, leaking canister of plutonium; guests Soon-Teck Oh, Rosalind Chao.
